Name: Maggs Sebastian Friendship Expansion Dialogue and Events
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[b][color=#8e7cc3][size=4]Quick Links[/size][/color][/b]
Looking for the Romance version? Here it is! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25841]Magg's Immersive Sebastian Romance Core[/url]

[b][color=#8e7cc3][size=4]IMPORTANT!! Installation[/size][/color][/b]
Download the zip file, then unzip it to your mods folder. See SMAPI for more help if needed.Updating: delete the old Magg’s folder in your mods folder, then unzip the new version to your mods folder.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764217843.png[/img]
Friendship dialogue and event expansion for Sebastian, adding character depth with dialogue and events up to 8 hearts.Sebastian's friendship with the farmer grows with his heart levels as he matures and changes, becoming more comfortable with himself and life in general. Seb makes peace with his past, reconciles with his family, and ends the first year with a network of friends in the valley.

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Nearly a full replacement of Sebastian’s vanilla dialogue along with a massive expansion up to 8 hearts. Includes unique dialogue for Sebastian nearly every day the first year.[/*]
[*]Unique dialogue for festivals for the first 2 years, updated lines for events like Green Rain, Ginger Island, Community Center, etc.[/*]
[*]Randomized rain and saloon dialogue based on heart level.[/*]
[*]25 new events plus updates to vanilla events.[/*]
[*]Sebastian keeps his vanilla pronouns/identity, this will not be changed.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218205.png[/img]
Quick list of major heart events and triggers:

[b]Moving Forward[/b]: day after seeing Gang Gossip, Town, 10 am - 7 pm (Note: Does not play if Immersive Sam is installed, it would duplicate a Sam event)

[b][color=#e06666]2 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Sebastian’s room

[b][color=#e06666]3 Hearts[/color]
Career Goals[/b]: 3 hearts with Sebastian, Sam, and Abigail, Saloon on Friday after 5 pm (Note: Does not play if Immersive Sam is installed, it would duplicate a Sam event)

[b][color=#e06666]4 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Mountain, 11 am to 5 pm
[b]Say That Again[/b]: have seen Vanilla 4-heart event, Beach, not spring, 8 am to 6 pm
[b]New Jam[/b]: unlocks 6 days after seeing Say That Again, Sam’s house when he's home, 10 am to 7 pm

[b][color=#e06666]6 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Sebastian’s room when he's home
[b]Chatterbox[/b]: have seen Vanilla 6-heart event, Carpenter's Shop when Robin is home
[b]Peas in a Pod[/b]: 6 hearts with Sebastian and Sam, have seen Chatterbox, Mountain, not rainy, after 8 pm

[b][color=#e06666]7 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Bones[/b]: unlocks 7 days after seeing Peas in a Pod, Mountain, not rainy, after 7 pm
[b]Frogs of Blue 1[/b]: unlocks 7 days after seeing Bones, Carpenter's Shop, Spring or Summer, 10 am to 2 pm
[b]Frogs of Blue 2[/b]: have seen Frogs of Blue 1, Mountain, 10 am to 6 pm
[b]Frogs of Blue 3[/b]: have seen Frogs of Blue 2, Sebastian's Room when Seb is home
[b]Frogs of Blue 4[/b]: have seen Frogs of Blue 3, Mountain, 10 am to 2 pm
[b]Frogs of Blue 5[/b]: have seen Frogs of Blue 4, Sebastian's Room when Seb is home
[b]Frogs of Blue 6[/b]: have seen Frogs of Blue 5, Carpenter's Shop, 10 am to 6 pm

[b][color=#e06666]8 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Beach, rainy, after 12 pm
[b]Level Up[/b]: have seen Vanilla 8-heart event, Sebastian’s room, Winter, after 12 pm
[b]Just a Game 1[/b]: unlocks 7 days after seeing Level Up, Sebastian's room when he's home
[b]Just a Game 2[/b]: have seen Just a Game 1, Sam's house when he's home
[b]Just a Game 3[/b]: have seen Just a Game 2 and received a letter invite, Sebastian's room when he's home
[b]Seb and the City[/b]: have seen Just a Game 3, Mountain, Monday, after 6 pm

[b][color=#e06666]Special Events[/color][/b] (not based on heart level)
[b]Spawn Date[/b]: Saloon, Winter 10
[b]Maru's Birthday[/b]: year 2 or later, Town, Summer 10, 10 am to 8 pm
[b]Maru's Birthday 2[/b]: have seen Maru’s Birthday 1, Carpenter's Shop, 9 am to 4 pm[/spoiler]

[b][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218459.png[/img][/size]
Spectrum dialogue[/b]
Sebastian's vanilla character demonstrates hints of mild autism. Select 'No' to disable dialogue developing this character aspect at a high level.

[b]Smoking variant[/b]
'Quit Smoking' follows the standard storyline. Select Keep Smoking to remove 'quitting smoking' dialogue from this mod. Select Non-smoking if you're running Magg's Non-Smoking Sebastian (or a similar mod) and you want no smoking dialogue at all.

[b]Farmer neutral pronouns[/b]
Select 'Yes' to use gender neutral pronouns for farmer.

[b]Keep Seb's aquarium[/b]
Select 'Yes' to keep the frog aquarium in Seb's room after the relevant event (this is not the same aquarium as his 14 heart event).

[b]Sam custom sprites[/b]
Select 'Yes' to enable Sam's custom sprites for a few small events, only works if you have Maggs Emo Sebastian Sprites or Maggs Slightly Cuter sprite patch installed.

[b]Other decor sprites[/b]
Select 'Yes' to add Seb's slippers, radio, and different pictures in his room. [/spoiler]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1764218055.png[/img]
Compatible with most mods, including SVE. RSV, East Scarpe, and Sunberry (other than Wren's story, which changes Sebastian's past but won't matter too much).
Highly recommended to use MH Event List to help track events.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39885]MH Event List[/url]﻿ Functions like Event Lookup, but includes many more features and shows the time gaps between events
